task.title: Say where you found it
task.shortdesc: Add a source to a fact, so you always know why you believe it.

prereq.p: Use a tree that already has a source in it. The sample tree has some: choose in the menu, then on its card. On , search for a person who has a birth date, and choose their card.

info.p: It starts with and ends with +.

step.cmd: Choose , then choose a source in the list.

stepresult.p: A second step opens, with the title of the source at the top.

step.cmd: In , type where to look in the source.

info.p: You can leave the other boxes as they are.

stepresult.p: The chip on the page shows one more source.

result.p: The fact now has a source. Later, when two records disagree, this is how you will know what to believe.
